description: Creates a product users buy in the app (neblla.shop.buy(productId)): one_time (once per user unless repeatable), consumable (by quantity), subscription (renews monthly or yearly) or donation (the buyer picks the amount). Amounts are in the currency's minor unit (cents). Options: stock, shipping (physical: each payment becomes an order), content (private links for the buyer), tokens (a token pack), seller (paid to another seller's Stripe). Live at once (no neblla_promote); without an active payout account it stays hidden and publishes itself once there is one. More: neblla_get_llms tools/create_product

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

content.description: Private links or texts only buyers read (neblla.media.mine()): for good, or while subscribed.

defaultLang.description: The language of a plain-string name and description.

description.description: A string, or one per language.

image.description: An https URL of its picture.

name.description: A string, or one per language: { en, es, … }.

pricePerUnit.description: consumable: the price of one unit.

productId.description: What the app's code calls it, e.g. "premium": 2-40 of a-z 0-9 _ -, unique, fixed for good. Left out: a random hex id.

repeatable.description: one_time: true lets the same user buy it again.

seller.description: One of the app's sellers (neblla_business sellers), "site:<id>" or "user:<id>", charged on its own Stripe. Left out: the app's payout account.

shipping.description: Physical: { zones: [{ name, countries: ["ES"], amount }] }, amount = postage in cents.

stock.description: one_time, consumable: units for sale in all (left out: no limit); then buys fail with sold_out.

stockRefundReturns.description: A refunded unit goes back on sale (default true).

tokens.description: one_time, consumable: tokens each unit gives (tokens module).

tokensKind.description: Which token balance it fills (default the app's tokens).

trialDays.description: subscription: free days before the first charge.

name: neblla_create_product
title: Create a product
